shellCopy.label: Hero body
shellCopy.value: Search the ache plainly. NaamRas puts one reviewed guide at the center, keeps the full shabad beneath it, and holds the next faithful paths close enough to follow without losing the thread.

shellCopy.label: Hero search hint
shellCopy.value: Search lands on the strongest reviewed guide first. The full shabad and the next return paths stay tied to it, so depth grows without duplicate pages pretending to be new insight.

shellCopy.label: Proof body
shellCopy.value: These counts stay honest in public. Nothing here is padded for volume; a page stays live only after human review and only while it can still serve a real day.

shellCopy.label: Proof footer
shellCopy.value: The library grows by restraint, not sprawl. Canonical guides hold the center, scenarios open the exact doorway, and cross-links deepen the reading without cloning the same insight under new names.

shellCopy.label: Guidance compact body
shellCopy.value: One line for the next hour, with a turn honest enough to carry back into the day.

shellCopy.label: Topic compact body
shellCopy.value: Read the guide first. Open the matching scenario when the pressure gets specific. Stay with the full shabad when you need the teaching in its full voice.

shellCopy.label: Detail body
shellCopy.value: Open one full detail surface at a time so the line, the guide, and the next faithful return stay in one continuous thread.

shellCopy.label: Topics intro body
shellCopy.value: Bring the question plainly. Start with the strongest guide, open the scenario closest to the pressure you are in, and let the full shabad show how the teaching widens the demand it makes on you.

shellCopy.label: Shabads intro body
shellCopy.value: Filter by theme, Guru, raag, depth, and what you have already kept close. Then stay with the whole shabad until context corrects the line that first arrested you.

shellCopy.label: Saved intro body
shellCopy.value: Saved pieces keep their shape. A line stays a line, a guide stays a guide, and a full shabad stays whole when you return.
